children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) looks neutral in a range of 4,893-4,946 ringgit per metric ton, and a break could suggest a direction.
A break below 4,893 ringgit may be followed by a drop toward 4,850 ringgit, while a break above 4,946 ringgit may lead to a gain into the 4,978-5,006 ringgit range.

The bias might be toward the downside, as the current fall is classified as the third part of a correction from the August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit. A rising trendline points to a target of 4,850 ringgit.
On the daily chart, a rising channel indicates a further fall toward 4,866 ringgit as well. Such a fall won't be considered a reversal of the uptrend until it extends below 4,814 ringgit.
As long as the market stays within the channel, it may climb towards the 5,166-5,217 ringgit range.
